2607.28317.title: One Human, $N$ Agents: Audit-Budget Allocation for LLM Agent Fleets under Miscalibrated, Correlated Confidence
2607.28317.paper_summary: A single human must audit $N$ LLM agents under a budget of $B \ll N$ audits per round, guided by self-reported confidence that may be adversarially miscalibrated and by correlated errors. We model this as budgeted noisy inspection over a two-level Gaussian copula and locate the miscalibration threshold $δ^*$ past which confidence-ranked auditing is \emph{worse} than random. Two a-priori expectations reverse: $δ^*$ \emph{rises} as the budget shrinks, and cross-family correlation is not low---shared difficulty dominates lineage. Five open-weight LLMs show operationally useless (near-constant) confidence, point estimates at or beyond the flip though CIs straddle it; a proprietary model is informative and lands below it. We give a quantitative criterion for \emph{vacuous} oversight, and replaying policies on recorded traces confirms the ordering.
2607.28317.paper_summary_zh: 一個人必須在每輪預算為 $B \ll N$ 的情況下，審核 $N$ 個 LLM 代理，並受到自我報告的信心指導，這可能會遭到對抗性錯誤的錯誤校準和相關錯誤的影響。我們將此建模為在兩層高斯共變數下的有預算噪音檢查，並確定錯誤校準閾值 $δ^*$，超過該閾值後，根據信心排名的審核將會比隨機審核更糟。兩個先驗期望發生逆轉：隨著預算縮減，$δ^*$ \emph{上升}，而跨家族相關性並不低——共享的困難主導了血統。五個開放權重的 LLM 顯示出操作上無用（近乎恆定）的信心，點估計在翻轉點或超過翻轉點，儘管置信區間跨越了它；一個專有模型則提供了有用的信息並低於該點。我們給出了一個 \emph{空洞} 監督的定量標準，並重播在記錄痕跡上的政策確認了排序。
